row:
Hello and welcome!
I'm a veterinarian and owner of Cat Care of Fayette - a feline only clinic in the south metro Atlanta area. We specialize in integrative feline and cater to exotic small mammals as well. 
I attended St. George's University in Grenada which is where this page started. Now, I'm here to showcase business management as a new grad and show case my life inside and outside of the practice.


For collaborations and business inquiries, please contact via Channel Pages:
http://ChannelPages.com/brittney-kilgore or DM me on Instagram
